{{Quote|A clean slate means opportunity. Imagine Imperial Tatooine as a bulwark against the Republic and underworld corruption throughout the Outer Rim.|Moff Yurrion shares his vision of the future|<ref name="Bonus">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Tatooine: Bonus Series|Tatooine}}</ref>}}
'''Merile Yurrion''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who held the rank of [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] in service of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], he acted as the sector overseer of the [[Arkanis sector/Legends|Arkanis sector]].

Yurrion believed that the desert [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] could be reshaped as a bulwark against the influence of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the criminal cartels of the Outer Rim. However, he did not have enough troops from the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]], and thus was forced to recruit [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] clans settled on Tatooine. Moff Yurrion recruited agents of the Empire who had completed their own personal agendas on Tatooine to assist him in this endeavor.<ref name="Bonus" />
